concept: A five-year-old child's empty chair or small shoes positioned in the center of a vast, desolate landscape—perhaps a desert or rubble field rendered in muted, desaturated tones. The chair casts a long shadow. Overhead, fragmented shapes suggest surveillance or weaponry. The composition is symmetrical and austere, emphasizing absence and scale. Render in a style reminiscent of memorial photography: stark, documentary-like, with minimal color palette dominated by grays, blacks, and a single muted accent tone. Bold geometric shapes, heavy pixelation-friendly forms.
explanation: Today's headlines are overwhelmed by violence, displacement, and loss of life—from the confirmed killing of a five-year-old girl pleading for help, to mass casualties in Brazil and Kenya, to the haunting discovery of remains in a dried reservoir. The child's voice calling for aid before her death demanded the most direct emotional response. Rather than depicting violence itself, I chose to represent absence and the weight of a small life cut short, allowing the viewer to project their own grief onto an empty space.

headlines.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
headlines.summary: The five-year old Gaza girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

headlines.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
headlines.summary: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

headlines.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
headlines.summary: The US president says the two sides are finalising documents to avert import taxes targeting a range of Canadian goods.

headlines.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
headlines.summary: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
headlines.summary: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.

headlines.title: Six tourists and pilot killed in Kenya helicopter crash
headlines.summary: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Department tells the BBC the nationalities are yet to be confirmed.

headlines.title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
headlines.summary: The skeletal remains in Lake Mead include what appears to be a human jaw with teeth attached, a witness says.

headlines.title: Head-on collision between bus and lorry in Brazil kills more than 20
headlines.summary: It is not yet clear what caused the two vehicles to crash into each other in the early hours of Wednesday morning.

headlines.title: Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
headlines.summary: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July and crashed into the Indian Ocean hadn't been seen since - but now Christmas Island residents say they have spotted it being towed just off their coast.

headlines.title: 'I was born in South Africa', says beauty queen facing legal bid to deport her
headlines.summary: Chidimma Adetshina is challenging efforts to have her deported from South Africa, which she says is her home.

headlines.title: Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation
headlines.summary: A judge's ruling on Tuesday removed the last remaining block on Trump officials' efforts to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians.

headlines.title: Angélique Kidjo becomes first African musician with Hollywood Walk of Fame star
headlines.summary: Without Africans, no music is possible on this planet, says the 66-year-old musical icon from Benin.
